evidence.title: VibeUI — 92 Free UI Prompts for Vibe Coders (Auth, Pricing, Hero, Bento)
About VibeUI — How to Use the UI Prompt Library

name: VibeUI
summary: Library of 92 copy-paste layout prompts for vibe coding: auth forms, pricing, hero, bento, stats, nav, footer, FAQ and more.
description: A prompt library for vibe coders: 92 structural prompts that describe the layout of a UI section, not its visual style, grouped in 15 categories (auth forms, pricing, features/bento, hero, CTA, stats, nav bars, testimonials, footer, FAQ, dashboards, onboarding, blog, contact, bonus). Copy a prompt, paste it into an AI tool together with a reference screenshot, and it mirrors that screenshot's aesthetic.
contains: auth forms: split-screen, centered card, magic link, multi-step wizard
pricing: 3-tier cards, monthly/annual toggle, comparison table, usage slider
each prompt ends with a line that matches the reference screenshot's style
copy button per card, search by name, keyboard shortcuts
prompts work with AI builders such as Lovable, Cursor, Bolt and v0
